name: jira-markdown
description: Cross-browser extension (Firefox + Chrome): bidirectional wiki ↔ Markdown converter with base64 image embedding

scripts.package:firefox: npm run build && npx web-ext build -s extension -a dist/firefox --overwrite-dest && V=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && cp "dist/firefox/wiki_markdown-${V}.zip" "dist/firefox/wiki_markdown-${V}.xpi"
scripts.package: npm run package:firefox && npm run package:chrome

author: zoonderkins
